summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K (Next Day Disclosure Return) under Hong Kong listing rules, detailing a change in issued shares. On May 29, 2026, 12,000 new Class A ordinary shares were issued at USD 5.33 per share upon exercise of share options by a non-director participant under a share scheme, increasing total issued shares to 840,500,967. The filing also reports multiple share repurchases for cancellation between March 20 and April 13, 2026, totaling over 10 million shares at prices ranging from USD 6.57 to 6.82 per share. The repurchases are disclosed as not yet cancelled. This is an open-market buyback program return, signaling management's view of undervaluation and commitment to returning capital. Watch for continued repurchase pace and potential cancellation effects on EPS.
